div.div: آبِقٌ A slave running away, or fleeing, &c.; a runaway, or fugitive, slave; part. n. of أَبَقَ; (Mgh, Msb, K;) as also ↓ أَبُوقٌ [but in an intensive, or frequentative, sense, i. e. who runs away, or flees, &c., much, or often; and so ↓ أَبَّاقٌ , occurring in the K, in art. ملخ]: (IF, K:) pl.أُبَّاقٌ (Mgh, Msb, K) and أٌبَّقٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
